name: libmochiberry
description: MochiBerry engine — embeddable C runtime with the JS engine, module loader and builtin library
consumers: the per-module repos under Mochi-Berry build against this engine's headers (mbjs.h, mbjs_runtime.h)
note: This repository is the engine source. It ships no prebuilt binary and no JavaScript package; the two layer directories exist so every repo in the org has the same shape and the loader can resolve them uniformly.
